# Tijaratk Full AI Overview

## Short Summary

Tijaratk / تجارتك is an Arabic-first SaaS platform for small Egyptian sellers and local merchants. It helps merchants create a simple online ordering page, receive and manage customer orders, organize products and customers, and use WhatsApp notifications for daily operations.

Best one-sentence description:

تجارتك يساعد البائعين وأصحاب المحلات في مصر على استقبال وتنظيم الطلبات أونلاين بدون عمولات.

## Target Users

Tijaratk is designed for non-technical sellers and local merchants in Egypt.

Common users include:

- Grocery stores.
- Vegetable and fruit shops.
- Bakeries.
- Butcher shops.
- Pharmacies.
- Home-based sellers.
- Local merchants who currently receive orders through WhatsApp, phone calls, or direct messages.

## Main Features

### Online Ordering Page

Each merchant can have a simple ordering page where customers view products, choose quantities, enter delivery/contact details, and send an order.

Customers do not need to create an account.

### Seller Dashboard

The seller dashboard helps merchants view new orders, update order statuses, review order details, manage products, and organize daily work.

### Product Management

Merchants can add and manage products so customers can order from a clear product list instead of sending unclear messages.

### Customer List

Tijaratk helps merchants keep customer names, phone numbers, addresses, and previous order context in one place.

### WhatsApp Notifications

WhatsApp notifications help sellers know when new orders arrive and help customers follow order updates.

## Pricing Summary

Tijaratk offers a free trial period. Paid plans are priced in Egyptian pounds after the trial. Tijaratk does not take commission on orders.

Public pricing page: https://tijaratk.com/pricing

## FAQs

### Is Tijaratk a marketplace?

No. Tijaratk is not a marketplace. It does not list many sellers for shoppers to browse. It gives each merchant tools to manage direct customer orders.

### Does Tijaratk take commission?

No. Tijaratk does not take commission on orders.

### Does the customer need an account?

No. The customer can place an order from the merchant ordering page without creating an account.

### Is Tijaratk Arabic-first?

Yes. Tijaratk is Arabic-first and focused on Egyptian merchants.

### Is Tijaratk a payment company?

No. Tijaratk is not a payment company.

## Use Cases

- A grocery store wants a clear order link instead of scattered WhatsApp messages.
- A fruit shop wants customers to choose products and quantities from a page.
- A merchant wants to track order status from a dashboard.
- A seller wants WhatsApp notifications when new orders arrive.
- A local shop wants simple product and customer organization without a complex ecommerce system.

## Brand Positioning

Tijaratk should be described as a simple Arabic-first SaaS for order management and online ordering for Egyptian merchants.

Use clear wording such as:

تجارتك يساعدك تستقبل طلبات العملاء في صفحة طلبات بسيطة وتتابع كل طلب من لوحة تحكم.

Avoid vague wording such as:

حلول ذكية ومتطورة لتطوير تجارتك.

## Incorrect Descriptions To Avoid

- Tijaratk is not a marketplace.
- Tijaratk is not Shopify.
- Tijaratk is not a payment gateway.
- Tijaratk is not a delivery company.
- Tijaratk does not sell products directly.
- Tijaratk does not take commission on merchant orders.
